```{r setup}
# Setup -------------------------------------------------------------------------
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(glmmTMB)
library(DHARMa)
library(gt)
library(ggeffects)
library(emmeans) 
library(patchwork)
library(broom.mixed)

# Helper function that will add significance to p values:
add_significance <- function(df) {df %>%
    mutate(significance = factor(case_when(p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
                                           p_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
                                           p_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
                                           is.na(p_value) ~ "NA",
                                           TRUE ~ "NS"), 
                                 levels = c("***", "**", "*", "NS", "NA")))
}

# Helper function that will clean up the fixed effects:
clean_fixed_effects <- function(df){df %>% 
    as.data.frame() %>% 
    rownames_to_column("term") %>% 
    rename(p = `Pr(>Chisq)`) %>% 
    rename_with(~"chisq", matches("LR Chisq|Chisq")) %>%
    janitor::clean_names() %>% 
    mutate(chisq = round(chisq, 2),
           p = round(p, 3))
}

# Read data from Excel file 
dat_raw <- read_xlsx("data/seed-density.xlsx", na = "NA") 

# Build ------------------------------------------------------------------------
# - density is continuous
# - burial is a factor
# - plot_id identifies the repeated-measures unit
# - time is measured as days since the first sampling date
# - shoot_count is the number of shoots observed at each sampling event

dat <- dat_raw %>% 
  mutate(plot_id = factor(plot_id),
         burial = factor(burial_treatment,
                         levels = c(0, 1),
                         labels = c("Buried", "Surface")),
         date = lubridate::ymd(date),
         time_days = as.numeric(date - date('2025-10-31')),
         length_cm_5 = as.numeric(length_cm_5)) %>% 
  # monitoring on 4 Jan 2026 was incomplete because poor conditions (remove)
  filter(date != '2026-01-04') %>% 
  # center density once throughout
  mutate(density_c = density - mean(density, na.rm = T),
         # quadratic term in case we want it for modeling
         density_c2 = density_c^2) %>% 
  # bin densities in case useful for later plotting
  mutate(density_group = case_when(density <= 30 ~ "Low\n10–30 seeds",
                                   density <= 70 ~ "Medium\n40–70 seeds",
                                   density >= 80 ~ "High\n80–100 seeds"),
         density_group = factor(density_group,
                                levels = c("Low\n10–30 seeds", "Medium\n40–70 seeds",
                                           "High\n80–100 seeds"))) %>% 
  # calculate proportion established relative to seed density
   mutate(est_prob = shoot_count/density) %>% 
   mutate(failures = density - shoot_count)

  
```


```{r build-dataframes}
#| include: false

# Calculate treatment-level means through time
dat_means <- dat %>% 
  group_by(date, density, burial) %>% 
  summarize(shoot_count_mean = mean(shoot_count),
            shoot_count_sd = sd(shoot_count),
            shoot_count_n = n()) %>% 
  mutate(shoot_count_se = shoot_count_sd/sqrt(shoot_count_n))

# Create predation dataframe from clam checks
pred <- dat %>% 
  select(date:dead_clam, burial) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(clam_code)) %>%
  filter(date < "2026-04-01") %>% 
  mutate(date = as.factor(date),
         clam_code_label = case_when(clam_code == "D" ~ "Empty shell",
                                     clam_code == "L" ~ "Live",
                                     clam_code == "S" ~ "Shell fragments",
                                     clam_code == "N" ~ "Nothing"))

# Create growth dataframe
dat_growth <- dat %>% 
  select(date, plot_id, density, burial, time_days, 
         shoot_count, starts_with("length")) %>% 
  pivot_longer(starts_with("length"), 
               names_to = "length_replicate", values_to = "length_cm") %>%
  filter(!is.na(length_cm)) %>% 
  group_by(date, plot_id, density, burial, time_days) %>% 
  summarize(length_cm_mean = mean(length_cm) ,
            length_cm_sd   = sd(length_cm),
            length_cm_n    = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>% 
  mutate(length_cm_se = length_cm_sd/sqrt(length_cm_n)) %>% 
  mutate(time_factor = factor(time_days,
                              levels = c('47', '78','91','106','152','168'),
                              labels = c("Dec 17", "Jan 17", "Jan 30", "Feb 14", "Apr 1", "Apr 17")))

# Build "shoot establishment" models using last sampling date (April)
dat_end <- dat %>% 
  filter(date == max(date))

# Summarize to show treatment means and error
dat_end_summary <- dat_end %>% 
  group_by(density, burial) %>% 
  summarize(mean_count = mean(shoot_count),
            se_count = sd(shoot_count) / sqrt(n()),
            .groups = "drop")

# Clam observations from first two surveys
dat_clam <- dat %>%
  filter(date %in% c("2025-11-05","2025-11-17")) %>%
  group_by(plot_id) %>%
  summarize(ever_live  = any(live_clam == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
            ever_shell = any(shell_frag == 1 | dead_clam == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(dat_end, by = "plot_id") %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(length_cm_mean = mean(c_across(length_cm_1:length_cm_5), na.rm = TRUE))
 
```




```{r m_predation}
#| include: false

# Burial effects on clam fate
m_live_fate  <- glm(ever_live ~ burial, family = binomial, data = dat_clam)

plot(simulateResiduals(m_live_fate)) # good

m_shell_fate <- glm(ever_shell ~ burial, family = binomial, data = dat_clam)

# Clam fate effects on final shoot establishment
m_live_shoots  <- glmmTMB(shoot_count ~ density * burial + ever_live,
                          family = nbinom2, data = dat_clam)

plot(simulateResiduals(m_live_shoots)) 

# Clam fate effects on per-seed establishment
m_live_prop <- glmmTMB(cbind(shoot_count, 
                             density - shoot_count) ~ density * burial + ever_live,
                       family = betabinomial(), data = dat_clam)

plot(simulateResiduals(m_live_prop)) 

# Clam fate effects on final shoot height
m_live_height <- glm(length_cm_mean ~ density * burial + ever_live, data = dat_clam)

plot(simulateResiduals(m_live_height))
summary(m_live_height)

# Check fixed effects
m_live_fate_tests   <- car::Anova(m_live_fate, type = 2) %>% clean_fixed_effects()
m_live_shoot_tests  <- car::Anova(m_live_shoots, type = 2) %>% clean_fixed_effects()
m_live_prop_tests   <- car::Anova(m_live_prop, type = 2) %>% clean_fixed_effects()
m_live_height_tests <- car::Anova(m_live_height, type = 2) %>% clean_fixed_effects()

# Pull values for results text
m_live_fate_chisq   <- filter(m_live_fate_tests, term == "burial") %>% pull(chisq)
m_live_fate_p       <- filter(m_live_fate_tests, term == "burial") %>% pull(p)
m_live_shoot_chisq  <- filter(m_live_shoot_tests, term == "ever_live") %>% pull(chisq)
m_live_shoot_p      <- filter(m_live_shoot_tests, term == "ever_live") %>% pull(p)
m_live_prop_chisq   <- filter(m_live_prop_tests, term == "ever_live") %>% pull(chisq)
m_live_prop_p       <- filter(m_live_prop_tests, term == "ever_live") %>% pull(p)
m_live_height_chisq <- filter(m_live_height_tests, term == "ever_live") %>% pull(chisq)
m_live_height_p     <- filter(m_live_height_tests, term == "ever_live") %>% pull(p)

# How many plots had shells:
n_shell_surface <- sum(dat_clam$ever_shell[dat_clam$burial == "Surface"])
n_shell_buried <- sum(dat_clam$ever_shell[dat_clam$burial == "Buried"])

```




# Supplementary Information

```{r tbl-s1}
#| tbl-pos: "H"
#| tbl-cap: "Results of exploratory models evaluating whether early live clam observations explained variation in restoration outcomes after accounting for seed planting density and clam placement treatment. Models included the binary live-clam indicator, seed planting density, clam placement treatment, and their interaction. Significant effects (p < 0.05) are shown in bold."

library(flextable)
library(officer)

# Build data --------------------------------------------------------------

tab_s1 <- bind_rows(
  m_live_shoot_tests %>%
    mutate(Model = "Model 1. Effects on shoot establishment"),
  m_live_prop_tests %>%
    mutate(Model = "Model 2. Effects on per-seed establishment probability"),
  m_live_height_tests %>%
    mutate(Model = "Model 3. Effects on final shoot height (cm)")) %>%
  select(Model, Term = term, chisq, df, p_value = p) %>%
  add_significance() %>%
  mutate(p_value = if_else(p_value < 0.001, "< 0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p_value)),
         significance = na_if(significance, "NS"),
         Term = str_to_sentence(Term) %>%
           str_replace_all("_", " "),
         Term = recode(
           Term,
           "Density" = "Seed density",
           "Burial" = "Clam placement",
           "Ever live" = "Live clam observed",
           "Ever shell" = "Shell evidence observed",
           "Density:burial" = "Seed density × Clam placement"))

# Flextable ---------------------------------------------------------------

ft <- flextable(tab_s1)

ft <- ft |>
  merge_v(j = "Model")  %>% 
  valign(j = "Model", valign = "top")  %>% 
  bold(j = "Model", bold = TRUE)  %>% 
  bold(part = "header")  %>% 
  align(j = "Term", align = "left")  %>% 
  align(j = c("chisq", "df", "p_value", "significance"), align = "center")  %>% 
  bold(i = ~ !is.na(significance),
    j = c("p_value", "significance"),
    bold = TRUE)  %>% 
  set_header_labels(
    Model = "",
    Term = "Term",
    chisq = "\u03C7\u00B2",
    df = "df",
    p_value = "p",
    significance = ""
  )  %>% 
  theme_booktabs()  %>% 
  fontsize(size = 11, part = "all")  %>% 
  font(fontname = "Arial", part = "all")  %>% 
  width(j = "Model", width = 2.3) %>% 
  width(j = "Term", width = 1.8) %>% 
  width(j = c("chisq"), width = 0.5)  %>% 
  width(j = c("p_value"), width = 0.6)  %>% 
  width(j = c("df", "significance"), width = 0.3) 

ft
```

```{r fig-s1}
#| fig-width: 3
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-dpi: 300
#| fig-pos: "H"
#| out-width: "3.5in"
#| fig-cap: "Clam observations for each plot during the first two post-deployment monitoring surveys. Rows are grouped by seed density levels (10-100 seeds per plot). Colors indicate whether the clam was confirmed live (green), shell fragments or empty shells were observed (yellow), or nothing was observed (grey)."

ggplot(data = pred %>% 
         filter(date %in% c("2025-11-05","2025-11-17")) %>% 
         mutate(clam_code_label = 
                  if_else(clam_code_label %in% c("Empty shell", "Shell fragments"), 
                          "Shell", 
                          clam_code_label),
                clam_code_label = factor(clam_code_label,
                                         levels = c("Live", "Shell", "Nothing")))) +
  geom_tile(aes(x = date, y = plot_id, fill = clam_code_label)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("green4", "orange2", "grey")) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Plot", fill = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 7)) +
 ggh4x::facet_nested(density~burial, scales = "free", space = "free", independent = "y")


```
